verdicts.reason: A keeps one centred axis and the original reading order (logo, headline, subline, shoe, CTA), but the logo, headline, subline and CTA are all tiny for a 432x768 canvas, so the shoe dominates and there are large empty bands between elements. B has the same undersized type, and its logo and Shop Now button are shifted left off the centred headline axis. B also puts the CTA above the product, leaving a big empty gap and dead space at the bottom, so its grid is broken and its order is jumbled.
